_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang unchanged at its tagged 0.43.0. beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.60.0, which adds the MCP request_reveal/check_reveal flow (paired with this release's own desktop-side support), the access-policy default flip, a Copy Result CSV button, canvas-mode relative-date where filters and keyboard column spotlighting, and a handful of New Layout/canvas fixes.
